fact: RSF states that journalist Dieudonne Niyonsenga (Ishema TV) was sentenced to seven years in prison for 'humiliating' state officials in 2021, and was still jailed in July 2024.
RSF states that Theoneste Nsengimana, director of Umubavu TV, was arrested in October 2021 while organising an event with opposition leader Victoire Ingabire, and was still held in July 2024.

An ARM project policy brief says that in 2019 the Rwandan Senate accused 26 online radio stations and websites of exiled critics of genocide denial and the websites were made inaccessible, with the regulator RURA giving no explanation or appeal.
